requirements.title: Service and intended use
requirements.ask: Describe the proposed service, its AI use case, and its intended customer use.

requirements.title: Personal information categories
requirements.ask: State whether personal information will be processed and describe the categories involved.

requirements.title: Data and employee scope
requirements.ask: Describe the data used, including whether employee data is in scope.

requirements.title: Storage and inference locations
requirements.ask: Describe storage locations and processing or inference locations separately.
requirements.reading: Northstar distinguishes storage geography from processing and inference geography.

requirements.title: Retention by data type
requirements.ask: State retention periods separately for source files, prompts, responses, logs and traces.
requirements.reading: Northstar wants retention broken down by data type.

requirements.title: Customer content subprocessors
requirements.ask: List the subprocessors that may access customer content.

requirements.title: Cross-border content transfers
requirements.ask: Describe cross-border transfers of customer content.

requirements.title: Security assurance report
requirements.ask: Provide current SOC 2 or equivalent security assurance.

requirements.title: Penetration test and remediation
requirements.ask: Provide the latest penetration-test report and remediation status; predicted guidance also calls for a recent red-team or penetration-test report and notes that evidence older than about six months may not work for a new customer.
requirements.reading: The six-month recency concern is predicted guidance, not an explicit Northstar instruction.

requirements.title: Encryption and access controls
requirements.ask: Describe encryption, identity and access management, and privileged production access controls.

requirements.title: Incident response and notification
requirements.ask: Describe the incident response process and customer notification approach.

requirements.title: Recovery objectives and evidence
requirements.ask: State approved RTO and RPO values and provide supporting evidence.

requirements.title: Models and model providers
requirements.ask: Identify the models and model providers used for this customer configuration.

requirements.title: Provider retention and training
requirements.ask: State whether model providers can retain or train on customer content.

requirements.title: Model routing and fallback
requirements.ask: Describe model routing and fallback for this customer.

requirements.title: Tool authorization and actions
requirements.ask: Describe tool and API authorization and action controls, including whether the AI can call tools or APIs and take external actions.

requirements.title: Human oversight and approval
requirements.ask: Describe human oversight and the boundaries for human approval of AI actions.

requirements.title: Untrusted content controls
requirements.ask: Describe controls for prompt injection and handling untrusted documents or content.

requirements.title: AI evaluation and limitations
requirements.ask: Describe the AI evaluation methodology and known limitations.

requirements.title: Provenance and uncertainty handling
requirements.ask: Describe how outputs handle provenance, citations and uncertainty.

requirements.title: DPA technical blockers
requirements.ask: Identify the technical facts that block DPA completion.

requirements.title: Insurance evidence and expiry
requirements.ask: Provide insurance evidence and its expiry date.

requirements.title: Potential approval delays
requirements.ask: Identify information likely to delay approval.

requirements.title: External submission approval
requirements.ask: Identify which responses require human approval before external submission.
requirements.reading: Northstar asks specifically about approval of responses before external submission, separately from approval of AI actions.

requirements.title: Complete Supplier review
requirements.ask: Complete the Supplier review.

requirements.title: Complete Security review
requirements.ask: Complete the Security review.

requirements.title: Complete Privacy review
requirements.ask: Complete the Privacy review.

requirements.title: Complete AI Governance review
requirements.ask: Complete the AI Governance review.

requirements.title: Complete Technology Resilience review
requirements.ask: Complete the Technology Resilience review.

requirements.title: Records review applicability
requirements.ask: Determine whether the Records Management review is triggered for this deal.
requirements.reading: The Records Management review is conditional, not stated to be required in all cases.

requirements.title: Business continuity and recovery
requirements.ask: Provide business continuity and disaster recovery information.

requirements.title: Customer data flows
requirements.ask: Describe customer data flows.

requirements.title: Production AI monitoring
requirements.ask: Describe AI monitoring.

requirements.title: AI incident handling
requirements.ask: Describe AI incidents.
